lines.text: A person or thing in chaos.
Today I'm a total hot mess.

data.mean: A person or thing in chaos.
data.define: Used for someone or something very messy.

example.text: Today I'm a total hot mess.

misuse.text: Don't call your boss a 'hot mess'.
